author: Glitchaye
body:
Hey guys, I finally decided to release this pack on a special day, my 16th birthday.

Just take note, I didnt make much in this pack, but I did make the hearts, armor icon, crit particles, and the exp bar. ( I also dont remember where I got stuff from ;-; )

Showcase : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mef3Vc6oM-g
D/L :http://www.mediafire.com/download/2gdctysusuik0xo/Vigour.zip
